description: This file declares a wrapper class 'Udev' and related structs for interfacing with the udev device manager API, including an interface class 'UdevImpl' with virtual functions for udev operations. It also declares external function pointers corresponding to udev functions and a macro for iteration over udev list entries.

classes.name: UdevImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class defining virtual methods for udev operations, intended for implementation by subclasses to provide udev functionality.

classes.name: Udev
classes.description: Wrapper class with static methods providing access to udev functionality, utilizing a static implementation pointer.

methods.name: Udev::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation object for Udev, allowing custom behavior or mocking.

methods.name: Udev::udev_enumerate_new
methods.description: Creates a new udev enumerate object.

methods.name: Udev::udev_enumerate_add_match_subsystem
methods.description: Adds a subsystem match to the device enumeration.

methods.name: Udev::udev_enumerate_scan_devices
methods.description: Scans devices matching the enumeration criteria.

methods.name: Udev::udev_enumerate_get_list_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the list of devices found during enumeration.

methods.name: Udev::udev_enumerate_unref
methods.description: Unreferences and frees the enumeration object.

methods.name: Udev::udev_unref
methods.description: Unreferences and frees the udev context.

methods.name: Udev::udev_list_entry_get_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name from a list entry.

methods.name: Udev::udev_device_new_from_syspath
methods.description: Creates a udev device object from a sysfs path.

methods.name: Udev::udev_device_unref
methods.description: Unreferences and frees a udev device object.

methods.name: Udev::udev_device_get_parent_with_subsystem_devtype
methods.description: Gets the parent device with specific subsystem and devtype.

methods.name: Udev::udev_device_get_devtype
methods.description: Retrieves the device type of a udev device.
